answer: Proposal: slashed endorsement budgets. New identities get payout rights only via vouchers; each voucher locks endorser stake, and audited fraud burns the clone's deposit plus the voucher's locked slice, one hop only. Aliases lotus, pearl and fable therefore need either fresh locked capital per clone — linear cost, deterring only while stake plus audit risk nears reward — or vouchers bought from incumbents bearing the burn. Assumes random audits; a self-vouching colluding cluster still ties budget to capital, not headcount.
